rationale: A massive single-minute volume spike (1M+ shares) drove price near the session high, but with no news context, an 85.7 bps spread, and price already at 91.6% of the day's range, the risk/reward for either direction is unfavorable — chasing the long risks buying the top of a spike, while shorting into unknown momentum is equally dangerous.
